summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin, and added test/test_sparql_prepare_update.py. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate returns an Update container built from the translated prologue; evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update passes containers through unchanged; prepareUpdate added in sparql/processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py. Deviation from spec: an empty request now returns Update(None, []) instead of an empty list, because an empty list would make evalUpdate raise and would break processUpdate(""). The spec's requirements conflict here and the user should confirm this choice. Nothing was run; all verification was by reading the code, so the new tests and existing DAWG and prepareQuery tests are unverified.
